tonight.headline: Golden is trending toward playing; Pickens is limited again
body: Bad news first: George Pickens, Matthew Golden's fallback, was limited again on Thursday with the shoulder and hamstring, and Dallas may give him a designation on Friday (RotoWire citing Machota, 29 Oct). Bloodsports are 1-6.

The better news broke after the morning brief: Golden (questionable, shoulder and foot) is 'trending towards playing tonight' — Ian Rapoport, and James Palmer reports the Packers expect him to suit up (4for4, CBS 29 Oct, ~14:10Z). Check Green Bay's inactives at 16:45 CDMX; if he is out, start Pickens before the 18:15 kickoff. ESPN: 126.6 to 121.1, 53%.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Metcalf Gala start Amon-Ra St. Brown, who went from DNP Wednesday to FULL Thursday on the ankle (Vikings.com/Lions report 29 Oct) — expect him at full strength.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Golden inactive and the swap not made: about 15 projected points become zero in a 5.5-point game.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · inactives Thu 16:45 CDMX · swap before 18:15 kickoff
doFirst.title: If Golden is inactive, Pickens takes his WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Questionable but trending toward playing (Rapoport, Palmer, Thursday morning). Check inactives at 16:45 CDMX.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Shoulder and foot. DNP Monday and Tuesday, limited at Wednesday's walkthrough; questionable. Since the morning brief: Rapoport says he is trending towards playing, and Palmer that the Packers expect him to suit up (4for4, CBS 29 Oct, both about 10:10 ET). A to Z: 'for now, the expectation is that he will play.'

case.label: The fallback
case.body: George Pickens, 14.0 — 1.1 below Golden, inside the coin-flip line. Limited Wednesday and again Thursday with shoulder and hamstring; Friday is his last chance at a full practice (RotoWire citing Machota 29 Oct). He plays Sunday 12:00, so a designation can still be covered.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Inactives 90 minutes before the 18:15 kickoff: 16:45 CDMX. Golden's slot locks at kickoff. If Golden sits and Pickens is then ruled out Friday, Rashee Rice (limited Wednesday, Sunday 15:25) takes the slot.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is active and Pickens outscores him (archive) — the contingency was right to exist but the tag was noise. If Golden sits, untestable.

whatWentWrong.title: Golden is still questionable — and Green Bay play Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: Shoulder and foot; DNP Monday and Tuesday, limited Wednesday. Now trending toward playing.

case.label: What happened
case.body: He played through the shoulder in Week 7 (12 targets, archive) and briefly left that game; the foot is new this week. Thursday morning Rapoport and Palmer both reported he is expected to play (4for4, CBS 29 Oct).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Do-first fallback: Pickens if he is inactive at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is active and plays a full share — then the questionable tag was precautionary.

starting.name: Jonathan Taylor
starting.detail: IND · @ JAX · SUN 12:00 · Daniel Jones · trade deadline 10 Nov

report.availability: ACTIVE — not on the Colts' report
report.checked: NBC 28 Oct (Steichen: no trade request); FantasyLife 27 Oct; ESPN/Fowler via Bleacher Report 29 Oct (heavy interest)
report.summary: ROLE_DOWN answered: McGowan's share has grown three straight weeks (34% of snaps in Week 7, FantasyLife) while Taylor still leads with about 20 carries a game and a league-high 8 rushing TDs. Analysts read McGowan's work as the Colts evaluating him before a possible Taylor trade — the 2-5 Colts dealt Nelson and Buckner on 27 Oct; Taylor says he 'hasn't heard anything' (NBC 29 Oct). Jacksonville 1st against backs (Statchasers, carried) — priced.
report.role: 18 carries, 3 targets in Week 7; 62% of the backfield
report.competition: Seth McGowan 34% of snaps in Week 7, third straight week above 20% (FantasyLife 27 Oct); DJ Giddens a healthy scratch
